item.title: Electronics
item.description:
My Passion for Electronics

Electronics has been my passion since childhood when I first connected a battery to a small light bulb and witnessed the magic of electricity. That simple moment sparked a lifelong fascination with electronic systems.

Areas of Interest

Circuit Design

I enjoy the process of designing circuits, from simple analog configurations to more complex digital systems. Understanding how components interact and creating efficient designs is both challenging and rewarding.

item.title: Books
item.description:
Books That Inspire and Inform Me

Reading has always been a cornerstone of my personal and professional development. Books offer a window into different worlds, perspectives, and knowledge domains. Here are some that have made a significant impact on my thinking:

Currently Reading

  • “The Pragmatic Programmer” by Andrew Hunt and David Thomas
    A classic in software development that offers practical advice for improving as a programmer and problem solver.

  • “The Innovators” by Walter Isaacson
    An exploration of the people who created the computer and the internet, providing valuable historical context for modern technology.

item.title: Photography
item.description:
Photography: Capturing Technology and Nature

Photography has become a meaningful creative outlet that complements my engineering work. While I’m fascinated by the technical aspects of cameras, what truly draws me to photography is the opportunity to document both the technological world I study and the natural world that inspires so much innovation.

My Photography Journey

My interest in photography began as an extension of my engineering mindset. Understanding the optics, mechanics, and digital processing involved in modern cameras appealed to my technical curiosity. However, as I practiced more, I discovered that photography also exercises a different part of my brain—encouraging me to focus on aesthetics, composition, and storytelling.
